{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"0000000000000246GP2M2SC611","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram @ -128,-64 flow=down box=256x128 grid=384x256
group repl "Replication" {
  node Handler "SubductionHandler" ref="edge/packages/services/db-service/src/worker/api-handler/subduction-handler.ts"
  node Replicator "AutomergeReplicator" ref="edge/packages/services/db-service/src/worker/subduction/subduction-automerge-replicator.ts"
  node Transport "Transport" ref="edge/packages/services/db-service/src/worker/subduction/subduction-transport.ts" color=orange
  node Storage "SedimentreeStore" ref="edge/packages/services/db-service/src/worker/subduction/do-sedimentree-storage.ts" color=green
  node Migrations "Migrations" ref="edge/packages/services/db-service/src/worker/subduction/migrations"
}
group index "Indexing" {
  node Indexer "Indexer" ref="edge/packages/services/db-service/src/worker/indexer/indexer.ts" color=violet
  node SubSource "SubductionSource" ref="edge/packages/services/db-service/src/worker/indexer/subduction-data-source.ts"
  node FeedSource "FeedSource" ref="edge/packages/services/db-service/src/worker/indexer/feed-data-source.ts"
  node Extract "ObjectExtraction" ref="edge/packages/services/db-service/src/worker/indexer/automerge-object-extraction.ts"
  node Alarms "AlarmScheduling" ref="edge/packages/services/db-service/src/worker/indexer/alarm-scheduling.ts"
}
group platform "Platform" color=light-violet {
  node Wasm "subduction-wasm" ref="edge/packages/sdk/edge-automerge" color=light-red
  node Bindings "DO bindings" ref="edge/packages/services/db-service/src/worker/bindings.ts"
}
edge Handler -> Replicator "sync"
edge Replicator -> Transport "messages"
edge Replicator -> Storage "fragments"
edge Replicator -> Migrations
edge Replicator -> Wasm
edge Replicator -> Bindings
edge Indexer -> SubSource
edge Indexer -> FeedSource
edge Indexer -> Alarms
edge Indexer -> Handler "doc reads"
edge SubSource -> Extract "objects"
edge SubSource -> Handler
edge FeedSource -> Bindings
